caption:
5 GTA 6 secrets and EXACTLY where they are 📍 Pinned on Rockstar's official Leonida map, each spot checked in at least two guides.

1. UFO: country roads east of Port Gellhorn, after 2 AM (not every night)
2. Skunk Ape (Bigfoot): Cottonmouth Lake, at night
3. Paul Walker's car: a villa garage on Vespucci Island
4. Dexter's apartment: Washington Island
5. Tommy Vercetti's portal: ends at the Turtle Head power station, 7 PM-6 AM

All 30 spots on our interactive map: vicereplay.com (link in bio).

Which one are you hunting first? 👇

Map: Rockstar Games (official). Sources: PowerPyx, The Click, Game8, GameSpot, GTABase, VICE, Red Bull.

Fan page, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
